slides.headline: SKIPPING NVIDIA 10 YEARS AGO COST YOU $1.58 MILLION

caption:
Nvidia just hit an all-time record, and $10,000 invested 10 years ago is worth $1,580,000 today.

Ten years ago, putting $10,000 into Nvidia instead of a savings account felt like gambling. Anyone who did it quietly has $1,580,000 today, while your cautious friend who played it safe has maybe $13,000. Nvidia is now worth $5.7 trillion. Someone is sitting at a table tonight doing the math on what they had $10,000 in ten years ago and quietly not finishing their food. The company that teens bought to make video games run smoother is now worth more than the entire economy of Germany.

This is what happens when one company ends up running the AI era. Nvidia went from gaming chips to powering every AI on earth, and the people who saw it a decade ago are now millionaires.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what the next decade could look like for yours.

Sources: The Kobeissi Letter on X, October 2, 2026

#Nvidia #investing #stockmarket #AI #tech
pinned_comment: Would you have held Nvidia for 10 years without selling, or would you have cashed out at a 5x or 10x somewhere along the way? Most people think they would have held. Most people are lying.
